recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is; no follow-up is needed for FHIR-13716 unless a future build-scope check shows generated artifacts diverging from the datatype spreadsheet.
issue_request: FHIR-13716 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 CDS change request asking to remove the redundant "event" prefix from TriggerDefinition element names; the approved resolution was to drop the prefix.
initial_application: The Jira comment references SVN 12254. In the git-svn history, commit 068f0b3582368d21cac3b59b0da22d37bd42edcb (build@12254) changed the TriggerDefinition datatype spreadsheet from TriggerDefinition.eventName, TriggerDefinition.eventTiming[x], and TriggerDefinition.eventData to TriggerDefinition.name, TriggerDefinition.timing[x], and TriggerDefinition.data. Commit 1d4d221110faed79a9a19bb0c58abeb8e9a07916 later added R3 diff mappings from the old names to the new names.
additional_context: TriggerDefinition remains active in source/fhir.ini and marked normative. The current source/datatypes/triggerdefinition.xml rows define TriggerDefinition.type, name, code, subscriptionTopic, timing[x], data, and condition. Searches found the old TriggerDefinition.event* paths only in source/fhir.ini [r3-renames], and Jira/Zulip/Confluence searches found no later or conflicting decision about the rename.
reconciliation: No source change was made because the authoritative current source already satisfies the issue. Removing the remaining [r3-renames] lines would break historical diff/compatibility metadata rather than improve the current specification.
